recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片上方有一團黏著的大細胞群，其中散布黑褐色粗大色素顆粒，下方血液背景中也見到含黑色色素的細胞，提示轉移性黑色素瘤（melanin色素）。
features: Low-power field with a cohesive cluster of large cells at the top of the smear
Coarse black-brown intracellular pigment (melanin) in many cells of the cluster
Scattered isolated pigment-laden cells and small clusters within the peripheral blood background
Large cells with abundant cytoplasm and prominent nuclei, though nuclear detail is limited at this magnification
Normal hematopoietic elements sparse in the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a cohesive aggregate of large cells at the edge of a particle, with numerous cells containing coarse black-brown cytoplasmic pigment. Similar pigmented cells and small clusters are scattered in the blood background. Nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic malignant melanoma involving the marrow; confirmation with immunostains (SOX10, S100, HMB-45, Melan-A) on the biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin appears as blue-green to golden refractile granules in dispersed histiocytes and is Prussian blue positive, whereas melanin is black-brown in cohesive atypical cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters but lacks melanin pigment and is keratin positive and SOX10 negative.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in cell-free areas in a different focal plane rather than within cytoplasm.
